retrieval_policy.current_job: Use only the supplied snapshot and locally authored kickoff materials. No external or restricted content was retrieved.
retrieval_policy.future_authorization: A later, explicitly authorized ingestion job may retrieve public course material; source repositories remain read-only inputs and retrieval must respect access controls and licensing.
required_provenance: requested URL or immutable source reference
content checksum and version or commit when available
validator-controlled classification as learner-safe, examiner-only, or unavailable
retrieval_policy.classification_rule: A catalog link or normalized resource record is discovery evidence only. It becomes neither available material nor an official course unit until content is acquired, verified, and explicitly classified.
retrieval_policy.student_view_rule: Never expose secrets, hidden tests, examiner rubrics, sealed references, or another learner's files. Only classified learner-safe copies may enter a student view.
retrieval_policy.failure_rule: If acquisition, integrity, licensing, or classification cannot be verified, keep the item blocked and do not infer or fabricate its contents.
